entities.summary: John Wiley Bryant is an American politician who has represented the 114th district in the Texas House of Representatives since 2023. A member of the Democratic Party, Bryant previously represented Texas's 5th congressional district in the United States House of Representatives from 1983 to 1997 and the 33-L district in the Texas House of Representatives from 1974 to 1983.
